title: Find E-commerce Brand Websites From a List With LinkFinder AI
coverSub: From a list of company names to their websites
cover: In this video we are going to see how to find the websites of a list of e-commerce brands using LinkFinder AI.
payoff: Here is what you end up with. 8 company names went in, and every one came back with its website, ready to export. Now let's see how.
outro: That's the whole flow: a list of companies in, websites out. Click the first link in the description to create your free account and run your own list. Next, watch how to find the LinkedIn page of every brand on a list.
outroHeadline: Find the store of every brand on your list
outroSub: Free account, credits included. First link in the description.

mocks._source: Real results from the LinkFinder AI API, 12 Nov 2026

click.text: I just need one lookup for now

steps.narration: Click Company website. It finds a brand's official website from its name, for one credit per company.
Fill in the company name. We type Allbirds.
In about two seconds you get allbirds dot com, the brand's own store.
Now do it for a whole list. Click Upload CSV, bulk.
Click Select File and pick your CSV. One column of company names is enough. Ours has 8, from Warby Parker to Skims.
You see the rows before anything runs, so you know exactly what you will spend.
The websites come in row by row while you watch.
8 companies in, 8 websites out, every one marked Found. One credit each.
Click Export to download the list as a CSV, ready for your CRM or your next enrichment.
